audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 3, 5 and 6 disagree with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirrored heimerdinger__tryndamere audit set the chart to Tryndamere / Heimerdinger for the five middle stages / Tryndamere. Level 1 is Tryndamere's because no turret exists yet; the two-item side-lane stage is his because Heimerdinger cannot answer a split alone.
audit.corrected: Tryndamere, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Tryndamere — proposed as one atomic full/content group with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 stage was written as Tryndamere's window in whys[4], spikes[1] and mid, while both layers' charts already gave the row to Heimerdinger — the page contradicted itself before I touched it.
audit.why: UPGRADE!!! (100/85/70s) amplifies his next spell, and an amplified grenade landing inside a full turret nest holds you there. Undying Rage prevents death; it does not shorten a stun, so the dive can still fail even when you survive it.
audit.corrected: At 6 UPGRADE!!! amplifies his grenade and his 100s ult beats your dive window.

audit.whatIsWrong: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is described only as a 'self-peel stun'. It stuns only what it directly hits.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.' Walking through the outer ring costs you a slow, not a stun — which changes every approach decision in the lane, and it is on a flat 11s at every rank.
audit.corrected: Only a direct CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stuns — its outer ring is just a slow, so sidestep the centre.

audit.why: 'Gain Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger' — he kites faster inside his own nest than outside it, so clearing turrets is not only about their damage.
audit.corrected: Pull him off the nest or clear it first; inside it he outruns you.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade is called a Q in 'early' and a W in wants.you[0]. It is his E. spikes[3] and 'late' both call it the 'CE grenade'.
audit.why: Packet defect: the page 'never names any of Heimerdinger's abilities'. Slot letters that contradict each other are worse than no name at all — a player tracking the wrong button commits into a stun that was never on cooldown.
audit.corrected: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E), Hextech Micro-Rockets (W), H-28 G Evolution Turret (Q), UPGRADE!!! (R).

edits.before: Level 1 is a skill farm phase before his turret zone comes fully online.
edits.after: Level 1 you can walk him down before the first turret is ever placed.

edits.before: Level 2 stays skill-based as you dodge poke and soak CS around his turrets.
edits.after: Level 2 is his: a turret plus 1325-range rockets out-range everything you have.

edits.before: Level 3 remains even while you clear turrets and avoid his grenade.
edits.after: Level 3 his grenade stuns on 11s and the nest punishes every step in.

edits.before: At level 6 R Undying Rage lets you dive through the turrets and kill him, favoring you.
edits.after: At 6 UPGRADE!!! amplifies his grenade, and his 100s ult beats your dive window.

edits.before: Level 6 is your window: R Undying Rage lets you dive through his turret damage and the R-upgraded grenade, tank the CC, and kill him — he has no escape, so if you save E to close after his W poke you win the all-in.
edits.after: At 6 his UPGRADE!!! amplifies the grenade and his nest does the killing while you are held. Undying Rage stops the death, not the crowd control — being stunned inside the nest for its whole duration is how a dive fails.

edits.before: Split-push away from his lane and only engage with R up — a full turret nest plus grenade stun can chain you long enough to kill even through your ult if you dive carelessly, so pick your dive when his CE grenade is down.
edits.after: Split-push away from his nest and dive only with Undying Rage up. Hextech Affinity gives him move speed beside his own turrets, so he kites faster inside the nest than outside it — pull him off it, or clear turrets before you commit.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are a farming struggle decided by skill — Heimer's turrets zone you off CS and poke you as you walk up, so soak what you can safely, avoid his Q grenade, and don't waste E trying to reach him through the nest.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours before a turret exists — walk him down. After that his nest zones you off CS, and CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade only stuns a direct hit: the outer ring just slows, so eat the edge rather than the centre.

edits.before: He reasserts control at first item with an R-upgraded turret and poke items, so play the sidelane and only dive when his CE grenade stun is on cooldown — with R up and turrets cleared first you still kill him at two-plus items.
edits.after: He reasserts control at first item with an UPGRADE!!! turret and poke items, so play the side lane and dive only on the grenade's 11s cooldown. UPGRADE!!! itself is 100s at rank 1 — bait it onto a turret and his stun stays ordinary.

edits.before: Save E to close only after his W grenade is used
edits.after: Spin in only after his E grenade has been spent

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E): 11s flat — only a direct hit stuns; the edge only slows. - Hextech Micro-Rockets (W): 11s at rank 1, 1325 range. - UPGRADE!!! (R): 100s at rank 1 — bait it onto a turret.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The grenade is 11s flat and only stuns a direct hit — take the edge.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Undying Rage stops the death, not the stun that sets it up.

edits.before: Track Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade (Stun): His self-peel stun. Dodge it. When it is down — Crit him down.
edits.after: Only a direct CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stuns — its outer ring is just a slow, so sidestep the centre.

notes: Left alone: diff is 'EVEN' while tone is the hard-lane red '#ff5d6c', diffRating is 8.5/10 and report[14] says 'Hard matchup' — in a lane won 51.1% over only 364 games. Also left alone per the mirror: the '~5 seconds' duration attributed to Undying Rage in breakdown.late and phases[4].why is not in Riot's kit text, so I did not repeat the number in any new sentence and used the 120/100/80s cooldown instead.
